frames.visible_job: Inside the dome, draw two narrow curves from near the crown down to the brim, slightly right of center. Join their upper ends with one short curve below the dome outline. Both lower ends touch the brim to make one raised reinforcing rib.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains one flattened closed brim. Its slightly flatter upper edge and broad bowed underside are easy to copy, with room above for the dome.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: The five crops move from brim to dome to reinforcing rib to three vents and highlight/rim/shadow, then yellow-orange fills. Both dome ends and rib ends meet the persistent upper brim line. The instructions explicitly darken vents and shadow before final color, matching the saved images.
